literal: Unlearned-people will-bind cruel-scepter that besides is-not to-the-earth burden.
translation: A harsh ruler who binds himself to ignorant counselors is the greatest burden to the earth; there is no other.
modern: அறிவில்லாதவர்களைத் தன்னிடம் சேர்த்துக்கொள்ளும் கொடுங்கோல் ஆட்சி தவிர, இந்தப் பூமிக்குப் பெரும் சுமை வேறு எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet identifies the worst possible burden for the earth: a harsh ruler who surrounds himself with ignorant advisors. The word 'கல்லார்' refers to those who lack proper learning and wisdom, while 'கடுங்கோல்' signifies a cruel and unjust administration. By stating that there is no burden other than this, the poet emphasizes that political tyranny combined with foolish counsel is heavier and more destructive than any physical weight the earth must bear.
